page.layout: Two medallion portraits side by side at the top (left: Andreas Doria, inscribed DORIA. ANDREAS; right: Philippinus, inscribed COMES PHILIPPINVS). Below them, one column of running text in two paragraphs. No marginal notes. Running head at top, page number at top left.

main_text.l: DORIA. ANDREAS
COMES PHILIPPINVS
ANDREAS Doria, nobili apud Genuenses ortus familia,
ineũte ętate nō vno sub principe stipedia meruit. Verùm cū se
terrestri Marte laudē inuenturū diffideret, ad suū rediit elemē-
tū:quatuórque triremibus à ciuibus suis præfectus, Gallorum
primū, mox Pōtificis partes fouit:à quo duabus auctus triremi-
bus,denuo sese ad Gallos cōuertit.Nec multò post vniuersę re-
giæ classi præfectus, & insigni equitum D. Michaëlis torque
exornatus, strenuam aliquandiu Regi operā nauauit. Post hæc
Marchione Vasti,aliísq; nōnullis Cæsarianarū partiū ducibus,
Philippini nepotis suí opera non procul à Neapoli captis, cùm
Rex eos ad se mitti identidem iuberet, iustúmq; redemptionis
pretiū eorum nomine offerret,Doria tantarū rerū successu ela-
tior factus,constanter id recusauit: tādémque Marchionis Va-
sti suafu[?] ad Cæsarem defecit: qui ob singularem rei naualis pe-
ritiam,tātum honoris ei detulit,vt non alio,quàm Patris nomi-
ne, eum vnquam salutauerit. Ciuibus quoque suis tam charus
extitit,vt marmoream illi statuam in foro posuerint, Patrísque
patriæ appellatione exornarint. Vide Paulum Iouium, & Sup-
plem. Chron.
PHILIPPINVS Doria, edito sub Vrbinatiū Duce sin-
gularis suæ virtutis specimine, Comitis dignitatē &prouentum
est adeptus.Rebúsq; deinde plurimis præclarissimē gestis, tan-
dem Andreæ patrui, Gallicæ classis præfecti, vice fungens, cum
Cæsarianis non procul à Neapoli nauali prælio congressus, insi-
gni victoria potitus est, anno 1527. capto Marchione Vasti, aliís-
que non paucis tũ Italorū tũ Hispanorū proceribus, triremibús-
que aliquot, partim captis, partim depressis. Et Biennio pòst in-
credibili pōpa copiarū Genuēsiū Dux adoptatus, post res pluri-
mas Caroli Cæsaris auspiciis feliciter gestas, fatis concessit.

page.notes: Medallion legends read from the engraved circles: left DORIA. ANDREAS; right COMES PHILIPPINVS. "suafu" in the Andreas paragraph is doubtful (word appears to be suasu or suafu); marked [?]. Otherwise the text is clear at the scan resolution.
